name: Edmar
source: Despite his high position at the court, Edmar prefers to avoid formalities and doesn't reveal his title unless the situation calls for it. He's one of the three remaining living descendants of the founder of the city whose blood carries an ancient generational curse. As scary as it may sound, however, Edmar and his family have learned to live with it and at times even use it to their own advantage.
